script:
control-agent-server api GET '<redacted:session-cookie>/%2e%2e/secret' --auth none --expect 400 \
  --check detail eq 'Invalid backend path' --save F29.proxy-path-traversal/dotdot
control-agent-server api GET '<redacted:session-cookie>/%252e%252e/secret' --auth none --expect 400 \
  --save F29.proxy-path-traversal/double-encoded
control-agent-server api GET '<redacted:session-cookie>/%25252e%25252e/secret' --auth none --expect 400
control-agent-server api GET '<redacted:session-cookie>/a%5cb' --auth none --expect 400
control-agent-server api GET '<redacted:session-cookie>/%2e/x' --auth none --expect 400
control-agent-server api POST '<redacted:session-cookie>/%2e%2e/x' --auth none --expect 400
control-agent-server ws listen '<redacted:session-cookie>/%2e%2e/ws' --auth none --header "Origin: $S" \
  --header "Cookie: oh_app_backend_session=$TOKEN" --duration 5 --expect-reject 403
control-agent-server api GET '<redacted:session-cookie>/app%2Ejs' --auth none --cookie "oh_app_backend_session=$TOKEN" \
  --expect 200 --check path eq /app.js
